description: WHO Global Health Observatory values for one country and one indicator (OData API): indicator name, year, sex or group breakdown, value with uncertainty interval. Up to 20 rows, newest year first. Default indicator is life expectancy at birth. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code, e.g. TUR

indicator.description: WHO indicator code, letters, digits and underscores (default WHOSIS_000001)

name: health_who_global_health_stats
title: Health Who Global Health Stats
